:::{#def-sufficient-condition}
#### Sufficient condition

When the proposition "if $P$, then $Q$" is true,
$P$ is a **sufficient condition** for $Q$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-necessary-condition}
#### Necessary condition

When the proposition "if $P$, then $Q$" is true,
$Q$ is a **necessary condition** for $P$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-necessary-sufficient}
#### Necessary and sufficient condition

When both "if $P$, then $Q$" and its converse (@def-converse) are true,
$P$ is a **necessary and sufficient condition** for $Q$
(@def-sufficient-condition, @def-necessary-condition),
written "$P$ if and only if $Q$".

:::
